question: In which Swiss city was the annual meeting of the World Economic Forum (WEF) held in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Davos**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Davos** is the host city of the annual World Economic Forum (WEF) meeting, which brings together global leaders, industry experts, and policymakers to discuss pressing global issues.
 
• The WEF Annual Meeting is traditionally held in January each year in Davos, Switzerland. It is known for addressing challenges such as climate change, economic inequality, and technological innovation.
 
• Davos is a famous resort town located in the Swiss Alps and is recognized for its global significance as a center for international cooperation and dialogue.
 
• The WEF was founded in 1971 by economist Klaus Schwab and has since grown into a major global platform for shaping economic and social policies.
 
• In addition to formal discussions, the event provides significant networking opportunities for leaders in various fields, fostering collaboration and partnerships on global challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zurich**

 
 
• Zurich is the largest city in Switzerland and a prominent financial hub globally.
 
• While Zurich is not the host city for the WEF, it is known for its banking and financial services industry, contributing significantly to Switzerland's economy.
 
• Zurich is also a cultural center, offering a mix of modern and historical attractions such as the Kunsthaus Zurich and the Old Town.
 
 
 
• **Geneva**
 
 
• Geneva is home to numerous international organizations, including the United Nations and the World Health Organization (WHO).
 
• It plays a key role in global diplomacy and is often referred to as the "Peace Capital" due to its contributions to international cooperation.
 
• Geneva also hosts the headquarters of the Red Cross and other humanitarian organizations, making it a city of global importance.
 
 
 
• **Vienna**
 
 
• Vienna, the capital of Austria, is a major center for arts, culture, and diplomacy.
 
• It hosts international organizations such as the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC).
 
• Vienna is renowned for its historical significance and is often ranked as one of the most livable cities in the world.
